title.narrative: Public finance for children with focus on increasing resource allocation for children was strengthened through evidence generation, building capacities for child-responsive budgeting, and enhancing social sector budget analysis. UNICEF Tajikistan’s support to the Ministry of Finance led to awareness raising of the local level actors on child-and gender-responsive budgeting, while a World Bank partnership enabled the endorsement of the methodology for child poverty measurement on a regular basis that will drive evidence based targeted actions to address child poverty and vulnerability in the country.
Routine measurement and reporting on child poverty is nationally owned
Extent to which national and local governance capacities for reducing child poverty at local level, have been enhanced with UNICEF support, including in humanitarian settings

Extent to which social sector budgets (including social protection) have been strengthened with UNICEFs support, for greater and better investments in children, including in humanitarian and fragile contexts
Evidence generated on budgets and their linkages to child outcomes to improve budget allocations/expenditure for children, Text
Strengthened capacity of stakeholders in budgeting at all levels of government to improve spending outcomes for children, Text
